analysis:
MARKET & REGIME: SPY is in a confirmed downtrend (-1.3% vs SMA50, 20d slope -0.43%). This is the single most important filter — quality-value strategies suffer their deepest drawdowns during broad market selloffs, not name-specific events. No new capital should be deployed aggressively into this environment.

PORTFOLIO STATUS: Already 86% deployed across 6 positions, which exceeds the 3-5 position target and leaves only $9,054 of headroom for new buys. The Sortino ratio of -5.92 is alarming — it indicates meaningful downside volatility relative to returns, which is exactly what we do NOT want in a capital-preservation mandate. Portfolio heat at 1.72% is low, suggesting stops are set appropriately, but concentration is high.

POSITION REVIEW:
• ULTA (+10.16%, $20,480): Thesis intact, largest position. At ~20% of equity, approaching concentration cap. Raise trailing stop toward $620 to protect gains.
• UHS (+9.54%, $19,601): Strong performer. Healthcare defensive characteristics help in downtrend. Hold with stop intact.
• ADSK (+8.01%, $12,957): Good gain. Technology in a downtrend market is a risk. Monitor SMA50 support; thesis intact while above it.
• FOXA (+4.60%, $12,586): Modest gain, stable. Defensive media characteristics. Hold.
• NXPI (+1.91%, $10,742): Barely moving in a market that has had sector tailwinds. Semiconductors are volatile in downtrends. This is the weakest position and may not be earning its capital allocation — flag for review if it fails to hold its SMA50.
• AMP (-5.06%, $9,869): Underperforming in a market downtrend. Financial services are cyclically sensitive. Loss is modest but direction is wrong. Watch closely — if AMP breaks below the original stop or $500 psychological level, exit without hesitation. Thesis depends on healthy capital markets; a prolonged downtrend undermines it.

NEW TRADE CANDIDATES: Multiple quality names pass the screen (TEL, PODD, EOG, COP, XOM, TXN) but:
1. Market is in DOWNTREND — the regime filter alone is sufficient reason to pass.
2. Only $9,054 headroom remains; meaningful sizing is impossible (a 1.5% risk on $100k = ~$1,500 risk budget; with PODD ATR ~$7 and 1.5x stop = $10.50 distance, max shares = ~143 but cap limits to ~59 shares at $9,054 — workable but marginal at best).
3. Energy names (EOG, COP, APA) are extended — range positions 83-89%, well above SMA200. Chasing extended uptrends in a down-market environment is exactly the late-cycle mistake to avoid.
4. We already have 6 positions; adding a 7th violates the 3-5 concentration discipline.

DECISION: Zero new trades. Protect existing winners (ULTA, UHS), monitor laggards (AMP, NXPI) for stop-outs, hold cash. A quiet book that avoids a drawdown in this environment IS the alpha. The honest benchmark is SPY+cash on a risk-adjusted basis — sitting 14% cash in a downtrend already improves that ratio versus being fully long.
